messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning a config-only soft rollup tonight to tweak routing policy and batching for text-gen workloads. change window 23:00-03:00 UTC. will do staged percentages: 3% -> 20% -> 100% with 30m observation.

ton y: Ack. Do we have rollback criteria spelled out?

maria: yes — proposed criteria: p95 latency increase >200ms for 10m, error rate >0.5% sustained 5m, or token cost/unit >5% over baseline. if any triggered, immediate rollback to last pinned config and pause roll.

olivia: Can you paste the config diff? want to validate no accidental TTL/health tweaks.

maria: Here — small snippet, config-only on routing + batching:

```yaml
routing: 
  priority_pools: ["dedicated", "shared"]
  fallback_policy: 
    - region: same
      max_routing_latency_ms: 120
    - region: fallback
      max_routing_latency_ms: 300
batching: 
  dynamic_batching: true
  max_batch_tokens: 4096
  max_batch_items: 16
  batch_wait_ms: 6
timeouts:
  request_timeout_ms: 60000
  kv_cache_ttl_ms: 300000
```

maria: Also enabling `prefer_low_cost_variants: true` for routing to steer some traffic to quantized instances (same model family, lower perf).

samir: Important: pinning — we should pin the canary group to commit `v2024-07-15-cfg` so workload uses expected kernel selection.

lee: +1 on pin. Also recommend marking the canary nodes with label `soft-rollup-2024-07` so metrics rollups filter correctly.

maria: rollout plan: deploy-bot will start 3% at 23:05 UTC for 30m. if healthy, bump 20% at 23:45, 100% at 01:00. manual hold allowed between steps.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued — plan: config-only deploy to cluster-prod-1, tag `soft-rollup-2024-07`. Canary group: 6 nodes. Starting at 1718457905 (23:05 UTC).

ton y: Observability — add temporary dashboards? need p95 latency, error rate, token-cost per request, routing miss rate, and per-pool throughput.

olivia: I'll open a short-lived dashboard and alert rules; set alert for p95 > 180ms (warning) and >200ms (critical). token-cost alert for >4% (warning) and >5% (critical).

samir: Also add a smoke test: run 200 synthetic requests through the routing path every minute during rollout to detect regressions in output latency/quality. Put eval set A for quality comparison; threshold: micro-diff score drop >1.5%.

maria: Agree. We'll keep the canary pinned to `v2024-07-15-cfg` and log the active kernel selection. If we see degraded quality, we'll immediately pin back to previous config.

lee: One operational note — because of `prefer_low_cost_variants`, some requests will hit quantized instances. Confirm that function/tool-calling and streaming behavior unchanged?

maria: Yes validated locally, but we'll watch streaming tail latency. If streaming latency p90 increases by >100ms, rollback.

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started — 3% traffic diverted to `soft-rollup-2024-07` at 1718457905. Monitoring hooks active.

(23:25) tony: Looks good so far. p95 ~ +25ms, errors flat. token-cost delta +1.2%.

(23:48) maria: Bumping to 20% now. holding 20m.

deploy-bot: Traffic bumped to 20% at 1718460480.

(00:10) olivia: warning alert fired (p95 > 180ms) for 7m. p95 peaked +210ms at 00:08.

maria: Got it. Initiating immediate rollback to pinned config.

deploy-bot: Rolling back config to `v2024-07-01-stable` as requested by maria at 1718461860. Traffic restored to baseline.

samir: Can we capture diff and record for postmortem? looks like batch_wait_ms=6 might be too aggressive for some models under 20% mixing to quantized instances.

lee: Add a follow-up test to incrementally adjust `batch_wait_ms` to 8 then 10 and re-evaluate. Also try `max_batch_items` 12 for that group.

maria: Agreed. Posting rollback notes in release ticket and scheduling a postmortem tomorrow 10:00 PT. We'll re-run a narrower canary after tweak and extra perf testing.

tony: Thanks everyone. Good catch on the runtime mix.

deploy-bot: Action items recorded: (1) postmortem ticket #RI-5231 created; (2) revert applied at 1718461860; (3) next attempt blocked until perf tests pass.

maria: Closing thread for live ops. Follow-up PR with tuned batching params and expanded perf tests coming from @samir.
